parsed_json.up: Select all IC50 activity rows in nM for human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
